controlled_hidden_word.exact_identifiability_argument: The joint law is a rank-K CP tensor Σ_j π1[j] L[:,j]⊗E[:,j]⊗R[:,j], where L=E diag(π0)P0ᵀdiag(π1)^−1 and R=E P1. If E is square full rank, π0>0, and P0,P1 are nonsingular, all three factors have column rank K; Kruskal uniqueness identifies E,L,R up to one common state permutation. Marginals recover π0,π1, then P1=E^−1R and P0=(E^−1L diag(π1))ᵀ diag(π0)^−1. A short-lag generator norm bound then gives Q_a=Log(P_a)/tau_a.
controlled_hidden_word.minimality_scope: One read contains no transition information. For K=m=4, unknown E(12)+pi(3)+two action transitions(24)=39 parameters, whereas two separate action-conditioned pair laws contain at most 2*(m^2−1)=30 degrees of freedom. Thus two-read pair data cannot generically identify all unknown parameters; the 3-read/two-transition word is the shortest generic tensor realization in this two-action design. This is not a claim that 3 reads are necessary for every calibrated or specially structured model.
controlled_hidden_word.principal_log_no_alias_sufficient_check: max_a tau_a*||Q_a||_1 < pi; in this explicit example it holds, so P_a=e^(tau_a Q_a) recovers Q_a by the principal matrix logarithm within this bounded class

moment_nullspace.theorem: For x={0,1,2,3}, each source has three rates and the two constraints ΣqΔx and Σq(Δx)^2. The displayed nonzero δ rows lie in their nullspace. Thus the two models have exactly identical chemical-Langevin drift and variance at every state for each intervention, but differ in third jump moment and in Q.

no_go.claim: If every hidden state has the same emission distribution, every controlled output word has the same law under both generators. No action sequence can identify hidden rates; a positive rank/conditioning assumption is necessary.

noise_and_sample_cost.finite_lag_bias: The hidden-word test uses exact exp(Q*tau) and has no infinitesimal-lag approximation bias. If rates are instead estimated by (P-I)/tau, ||P-I-tau Q||_1 <= exp(tau||Q||_1)-1-tau||Q||_1; this finite-lag remainder must be charged separately.
noise_and_sample_cost.independent_unit: one lineage observed at three scheduled timepoints; no pseudoreplication across progeny

known_nuisance_simple_test.interpretation: For the displayed E,pi instance only, if both predicted categorical word laws are known, use the TV-optimal binary event and threshold its frequency.

unknown_nuisance_profile_test.current_decision: UNKNOWN for a uniform numeric sample count; no nuisance boxes or profiled margin certificate were supplied.
unknown_nuisance_profile_test.lineages_sufficient_if_gamma_certified: ceil(8/gamma^2 * log((2^(4^3)-2)/delta)) using the finite-alphabet L1 concentration bound and nearest-set classification
unknown_nuisance_profile_test.required_assumptions_for_uniform_finite_: compact parameter boxes; emission singular value >= kappa0>0; pi_i>=eta>0; bounded rates and sampling times; alternative pair families separated after quotienting common state permutations
unknown_nuisance_profile_test.required_certified_composite_margin: gamma = inf_{P in H_A, R in H_B} ||P-R||_1 > 0 for the length-3 observable-word laws, optimizing over all unknown emissions, initial distributions, rate boxes, state coordinates, and dose nuisances

unknown_per_model_parameters.add_if_state_coordinates_not_calibrated: 3 free coordinates after fixing origin (or 4 if absolute origin is meaningful)

routine_prior_art_boundary: Unknown full-rank HMM realization from three observations is standard (Allman-Matias-Rhodes 2009; Gassiat-Cleynen-Robin 2016); controlled-HMM observability/reconstructibility is also established (Liu-Bitmead 2010).

The present witness is not claimed novel: its load-bearing point is the explicit smallest scalar-state actionwise moment-matched CTMC pair satisfying the strengthened same-b(x), A(x) quantifier, followed by an ordinary full-rank controlled-HMM word that separates them.
